description: Donanım Geliştirme ekibi olarak NASA Space Apps Challenge için uzay temalı bir oyun geliştireceğiz. Yazılım, oyun tasarımı, görsel tasarım ve hikâye oluşturma konularına ilgi duyan; ekip çalışmasına açık katılımcılar arıyoruz. Deneyim şart değil, birlikte öğrenip üreteceğiz.
summary: Mission Apex is a short, Turkish-language pixel-art game built in GDevelop. On the way to Mars, debris strikes a spacecraft carrying four astronauts. Playing as John, you must land on the Moon, find out what broke and work with your crew to get home. The landing sequence uses NASA’s value for lunar surface gravity. Players watch their altitude and vertical speed and decide when to fire the thrusters. On the surface, damage reports become clues to the parts the crew needs. The game gives students a chance to learn what a gravity measurement means by making a landing decision themselves.
details:
The player controls John. After an impact cuts power, Bob shuts down thrust and John takes over the descent. The player reads altitude and vertical speed together, pressing E to brake. We used a lunar surface gravity of 1.62 m/s² in this simplified model. Touching down below 4 m/s is a target we chose for gameplay.

Once on the Moon, John and Karla inspect the solar panel, battery and oxygen system. Bob and David report from inside the spacecraft. At the radio station, the crew compares findings. Players then search satellite and rocket debris for a hinge, a battery jumper and a pressure seal before testing the repaired systems and lifting off.

We built this roughly ten-minute adventure with GDevelop 5 and JavaScript events. Turkish dialogue, portraits and on-screen flight hints help first-time players follow the mission. We designed the landing so players can see how each thruster pulse changes their descent speed.
